reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x00410240 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/define/00410240-DefineHumanPlayerWeaponCategory.cpp at sha256 820b8f1e979798b4d0af7b6963fe682294de34b19478e4ee9bfd5983446d306c (recorded implementation.signature: int32_t DefineHumanPlayerWeaponCategory(int32_t param_1, float param_2);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

retail_function.name: DefineHumanPlayerWeaponCategory
retail_function.summary: Seven blocks 0x410240-0x4102CF: two nested loops over the category table 0x0056E0A4 (stride 9 dwords) and the frame; each iteration calls Script_EvalArgInt(frame,i) and stores into the table, then memcpy(context,{1,0,0x3FF00000,&g_script_ret_type},0x18) and returns context.

checks.name: abi_and_signature
checks.detail: BN int32_t(int32_t arg1, float arg2 @ 0xc): the frame is at [E+0xc]; the candidate's arg2 is at [E+8].The retail frame slot is [E+0xc] (BN already models it as arg2/arg3 with an explicit @ 0xc offset). The candidate declaration puts its second (or third) parameter at [E+8], the registered argc slot, so the same source compiled into the QVM call site would read the wrong stack word.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "int32_t(int32_t arg1, float arg2 @ 0xc)" at 0x00410240; radare2 recovers "fcn.00410240 (int32_t arg_30h_2, int32_t arg_30h);". Both tools place the entry at 0x00410240 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: int32_t DefineHumanPlayerWeaponCategory(int32_t param_1, float param_2);. The candidate declaration is separately recorded as divergent below and does not satisfy the retail ABI.
